name: Restaurant Food Safety Audit (RFSA)
description: Second-party restaurant food-safety audit (MEA food-safety team form, updated April 2016): sixteen sections from calibration to integrated pest management.
instructions:
Items tagged with country codes in their metadata apply only to those countries; items without a tag apply everywhere.
Grading: 95.0-100 = A, 90.0-94.9 = B, 80.0-89.9 = C, below 80 = F. An item marked critical (a failure shown as “/F” in the source form) makes the whole audit an automatic F.
Action plan timelines by risk: Low (does not directly affect hygiene or food safety) - by the next audit; Medium (could affect hygiene or food safety) - within 1 month; High (increased food-safety risk) - within 1 week; Critical (unacceptable, affects food safety) - immediately.
